thread:
Kai: Quick heads-up: We're GA'ing 'OpenAPI Streams v1' with Edge-Lite tool-calling today. Rolling out by region over the next 3 hours. :tada:
Mira: Thank you team! This unlocks lower-latency tool calls for mobile and edge deployments.
Devin: Migration concerns? Breaking behavior?
Kai: No forced migrations. New projects default to OpenAPI Streams. We provide a migration helper and reversible aliasing for 30 days.
Sam: Staged SDKs and examples are live in staging. Minimal SSE example:
```
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/openapi/streams 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"edge-lite-2","input":"ping"}'
```
Sam: Important: tool-calling requires `X-Redwood-Tool-Call: true` and the OpenAPI `tools` block. See docs.
docs-bot: docs: /openapi/streams migration guide published -> https://redwood.ai/docs/openapi-streams/migration
deploy-bot: canary deploy started us-west-2 at 2008604350.
Devin: Can we get perf SLIs? p50/p95 ballpark?
ops-oncall: Early canary: p50 ~ 48ms, p95 ~ 160ms on typical traces. Error rate low. Monitoring for 30m.
Mira: Marketing will publish a short announcement, no SLA claims. Product will send customer emails in 45 minutes.
Kai: Action items: docs smoke test, SDK publish, support rotation notified. Tag me on urgent issues.
Sam: Added quickstart Postman collection. Also note: quantization encoder change may affect extreme corner cases.
Mira: Thanks all — pushing to prod after the canary window clears. :rocket:
